title: Proportion of Outrage of Modesty Cases Within Residential Premises Involving Offenders Who Exploited Positions of Trust or Power
what_it_is: Proportion of Outrage of Modesty Cases Within Residential Premises Involving Offenders Who Exploited Positions of Trust or Power

sections.label: Outrage of modesty cases
sections.summary: Of 227 outrage of modesty cases in residential premises in first half 2026, 38% involved victims under 16; Government takes sexual crimes seriously.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Of the 227 recorded cases of outrage of modesty that occurred within residential premises in the first half of 2026, 38% of these cases involved victims under the age of 16.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government takes a serious view of sexual crimes.

sections.label: Police S.P.O.T. action protocol
sections.summary: Police launched an action protocol for responding to sexual crimes, with key principles S.P.O.T.: spot it, protect, observe, tell Police.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police have also launched an action protocol for people to respond to sexual crimes, including outrage of modesty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Senior Minister, Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The key principles are, using the acronym S.P.O.T. – first, "S", to spot it; second, "P", to protect the victim and oneself; third, "O", observe key details; and fourth, "T", tell the Police.

sections.label: Support for sexual crime victims
sections.summary: Victims can select crime report at kiosks for priority private attention, and younger victims have multi-disciplinary interviews with MSF and KK Hospital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: For example, victims reporting sexual crimes at Police stations can already select "crime report" option at queue management kiosks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: This ensures that they are prioritised and they are attended to in a private area, protecting their privacy and reducing exposure to public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: For younger victims, there are the multi-disciplinary interviews that are conducted with the Ministry of Social and Family Development, and the KK Women's and Children's Hospital.

sections.label: Under-reporting figures not ascertainable
sections.summary: The speaker cannot ascertain or confirm whether or not the figures are under reported.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: Whether or not the figures are under reported, that is not something that I can ascertain, or I can confirm.
